notes.title: Log Away is Coming Soon
notes.content:
[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] Log Away release date moved to Coming Soon
[*] We're adding new items, making gameplay tweaks, optimizing, and fixing bugs
[/list]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36323968/871689a5b6298c74fe6d0cbf918f96e4f6d0bb90.png[/img]

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]
Goodbye August, hello Coming Soon. We moved the release date from August to an unspecified time, shrouded in mystery for now. The remaining work (described below) won't take us much more time. We're really getting close!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36323968/32a8fa4678651337f13fef62899b3f49159a054e.png[/img]

[h1]The Work[/h1]
We are adding new items! Log Away already had more than 500; that was a lot, wasn't it? Well, now it's growing even bigger, in all categories: building, furnishing, and decorating. For instance, porches! Porches will definitely increase the coziness of your log cabin.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36323968/c5d168e6ed4665b9b19660b02decc98d8e26b93b.png[/img]

As players, you need a smooth and intuitive gameplay experience. It's a fundamental principle for all video games, but it's especially important for Log Away, which aims to provide a relaxing experience. That's why we're tweaking several small details, such as the controls, the user interface, and how you build and interact with the environment.

Last but not least, we're optimizing the game to run as smoothly as possible on older configurations, plus the dreaded task of all - searching for and removing bugs.

To sum up. It's a lot of work, but most of these tasks started a few weeks back, so we're really getting close to the finish line.

Don't forget to follow and add the game to your wish list!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468400/Log_Away/

Stay tuned for the release date announcement!

notes.title: Grab Now the Art and Sound of Saint Kotar!
notes.content:
Saint Kotar: Digital Deluxe Edition is now available! This special edition includes:
[list]
[*] Saint Kotar: Base game
[*] Saint Kotar: The Ritual DLC
[*] The Art of Saint Kotar: Digital Artbook in PDF format
[*] The Sound of Saint Kotar: Saint Kotar official soundtrack in both MP3 and WAV format
[/list]
Buy it here: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31640/Saint_Kotar_Digital_Deluxe_Edition/

Spanning nearly 70 pages, [b]The Art of Saint Kotar[/b] includes many materials that have never been revealed in public before. It's a book that showcases a selection of ideas, research materials, concept artwork, and final artwork. Years of work and passion put on paper. Much of what you see in there didn't make it to the final game, yet it was still helpful in reaching the end.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36323968/5c4fa358d6fa32e4ca78d80273d00c14086bf2dc.jpg[/img]

[b]The Sound of Saint Kotar[/b] includes a total of 22 tracks, both in MP3 and WAV format, featured in the base game and The Ritual DLC. Its mysterious atmosphere and creaking noises will set the mood to play Saint Kotar, or, for that matter, any work with a mysterious premise.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36323968/eb2bda0a6af514895e3cb1690cdf767659003133.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Out Now - Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man
notes.content:
It's release day! Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man is [b]out now[/b] for Windows, Mac, and Linux with a 15% launch discount! ːsteamhappyː

[h3]What The Crawling Man is[/h3]
Told in the form of an interactive comic book with sounds and animations, Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man follows the appalling life of Mojse - his fall from a beloved teacher to a bitter and vengeful leader of a sinister cult.

Mojse is one of the main characters in the full game Saint Kotar, and this horror-mystery-drama story is about his life and the dark events that forged him into the person he is when you encounter him in the game.

[h3]What The Crawling Man is not[/h3]
Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man is not just a regular comic book where you scroll pages and read. It features so many things that it is actually a sort of hybrid between a game and an interactive visual novel.

[i]The Crawling Man features:[/i]

[list]
[*]Interactive panels with animations and the parallax effect
[*]Sound effects and Soundtrack
[*]Voice overs (screams, gasps, whispers, etc) that add so much to the overall experience
[*]Support for Cloud Saves
[*]Achievements
[*]Full Controller Support
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186240/Saint_Kotar_The_Crawling_Man/

notes.title: Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man arrives December 2!
notes.content:
On [b]December 2nd, 2022[/b], the world of Saint Kotar expands with [b][i]Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man[/i][/b]!

Told in the form of an interactive comic book (or, short visual novel, if you prefer) with sounds and animations, Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man follows the appalling life of Mojse, his fall from a beloved teacher to a bitter and vengeful leader of a sinister cult.

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Interactive panels with animations and the parallax effect
[*]Sound effects and Soundtrack
[*]Cloud Saves
[*]Achievements
[*]Full Controller Support
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186240/Saint_Kotar_The_Crawling_Man/

Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man is the first story in the series of interactive comic books set in the world of Saint Kotar. The series, titled [b]Saint Kotar: Tales from the Cursed Valley[/b], is a collection of stories about the characters encountered in the adventure game Saint Kotar.

Learn more: https://redmartyr.com/works/51/saint-kotar-the-crawling-man/
